accepted_statement: For every integer n = 4k + 1 with k > 0, there is a tame knot in S^3 of determinant n and signature 4.
genus_bound: At most 2 outside the remaining square case; at most 3 in that case.
attribution: Reconstruction of Ferudun 2026 Theorem 1.1 and Lemmas 3.1-3.2, DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23111900.
